sentences.text: Harashit Mondal @ Sanjiban vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024

Author: Arijit Banerjee
Bench: Arijit Banerjee
15-07-2024 (ct. no.28) debajyoti (allowed) Crm (Db) 2076 of 2024 In re: An application for bail
under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Krishnaganj Police Station
Case No.506 of 2022 dated 16-12-2022 under Sections 363/365/34 of the Indian Penal Code and
added Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual
Offences Act.
-And-
In the matter of : Harashit Mondal @ Sanjiban .... Petitioner.
Mr. Prabir Majumder ...
For the Petitioner.
Mr. Saibal Bapuli, learned App, Ms. Dhanasree Biswas ...
For the State.
Mr. Sourav Mukherjee ... For the victim girl.
The petitioner says that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
He has married the victim girl.
A child has been born out of such marriage.
The victim girl is residing at the matrimonial home with the parents of the petitioner.
The petitioner is in custody for 219 days.
Learned advocate for the defacto complainant supports the submission made on behalf of the petitioner.
Learned advocate for the State says that there is nothing to the aforesaid effect in the statement of the victim girl recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
He opposes the prayer for bail.

Considering that the victim girl is living in the matrimonial home presently, i.e., the petitioner's house with the petitioner's parents, we are inclined to allow the petitioner's prayer for bail.
Signed By :
DEBAJYOTI DAS High Court of Calcutta 15 th of July 2024 05:52:16 PM

Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner, namely, Harashit Mondal @ Sanjiban,
shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand), with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of learned Judge, Special Court under POCSO Act, Krishnagar, Nadia.
